scope: 18 distinct qualitative Senate outlooks, supplementing the 17 existing numerical Original Ervin forecasts
method: Qualitative Senate election publisher rating without inventing a numerical margin. Idaho is Republican versus independent; no D-R correction applied.

AL.basis: Publisher qualitative rating. Not a numeric Original Ervin model, polling average, vote-margin forecast or win probability; federal same-state historical calibration not yet documented.
